summary: Frontend-only regression on Smart LED Matrix BLE app. All requested flows PASS on mobile web viewport (390x844): (1) Header bug fix — 'INFO WALL' title is fully visible and NOT overlapped/clipped; title & gear are on the same top row (title right edge 332px <= gear left edge 340px), and the connection-status-pill sits on a separate row below the title (y=58 vs title y=16). (2) Polygon Undo — with default zip 28117 resolved to Mooresville, NC, opening the map peek and switching to POLYGON mode hides the radius slider; tapping 4 points on map-image produced 'Polygon: 4 pts'; poly-undo decreased the count to exactly 3 (removes only the last point); poly-clear reset to 'Tap map to add points'. (3) Radius/Polygon toggle — map-radius-slider present in radius mode, hidden in polygon mode, returns when switching back. (4) Profiles — Settings modal opens, WALL PROFILES section renders with existing 'Info Wall' chip and add-profile-button; tapping add creates a new 'New Wall' profile (chip count 1 -> 2). (5) No console errors or page errors observed during any interaction. Reconnect-banner did not appear as expected (no prior BLE device saved in fresh preview) and no crash occurred.
critical_code_review_comments: app/index.tsx is ~1700 lines — consider splitting into per-section components (Hero/Header, WeatherSection, SportsSection, MapPeek, TileMap) to keep files under 700 lines.

handleMapPress relies on Pressable's e.nativeEvent.locationX/Y which is not guaranteed on web; on mobile web this happens to work via layerX/Y but a Gesture/View onLayout-based coord conversion would be more robust across platforms.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fresh web preview has no LAST_DEVICE saved, so reconnect-banner (testID 'reconnect-banner') won't render — that is expected per PRD note. Default zip 28117 resolves via Zippopotam.us to Mooresville, NC in ~1s; map peek opens via coord-preview. Polygon mode point add is done via page.mouse.click on the map-image bounding box (Pressable with locationX/Y works on mobile web viewport).
